name: Volumetric Particle Injection
definition: A technique where volumetric particles (smoke, steam, energy discharges) are injected as density into a frustum-aligned froxel grid, allowing them to be lit by the same scattering pass as global fog, avoiding visible seams from decoupled lighting models.
summary: Volumetric Particle Injection unifies discrete particles with global fog density in a froxel grid to ensure consistent lighting and eliminate seams.
